Name: MixedBag's Tilesheets
Author: JefGrizli
Description:
Nothing more than the title suggests. A seemingly random collection of tilesheets aiming to enrich the game. (And yet, it's all pathways)
The more you put in it, the bigger it grows. I'm no scientist, but I think that's how bags work.


All assets come in vanilla colours and native support for:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14668]Nari's Naturally Valley v1.0.0[/url]﻿ [[color=#e06666]support of later versions discontinued![/color]]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial[/url]

[u]Config Options
[/u][spoiler]
Pathway
[list]
[*]Rounded Corners: toggles roundness of pathway corners;
[color=#b6b6b6][true/false;[color=#b6b6b6] [/color][color=#d8d8d8]false[/color][color=#b6b6b6] by default][/color][/color][/list]Starblue
[list]
[*]Blue Spring: toggles grass colour to blue during spring;
[color=#b6b6b6][true/false;[color=#b6b6b6] [/color][color=#d8d8d8]false[/color][color=#b6b6b6] by default][/color][/color][/list]Wittily
[list]
[*]Light Dirt: toggles light dirt colours;
[color=#b6b6b6][true/false;[color=#b6b6b6] [/color][color=#d8d8d8]false[/color][color=#b6b6b6] by default][/color][/color][/list]
[/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Guaranteeing Functionality[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing but load those tilesheets into the game along replacing certain tiles with modified versions.
Just list it as a requirement/dependency should you use or edit any of these assets in your mod.
Now on [url=https://github.com/notsemisu/MixedBag-s-Tilesheets]GitHub[/url]﻿, v1.0.1 - v3.1.1
